name: My architecture style
description: TEMPLATE. Describe the style and how a diagram must be prepared for it (which tags to set on which elements). Work through the file top to bottom; the full specification is docs/conformance-profile-format.md. The file stays invalid until both values under "edges" are chosen.

roleA.description: Replace: a kind of element in this style. Recognised by a tag, e.g. role=roleA, and optionally by its type (entity, container, text).

roleB.description: Replace: another kind of element. Several values can match one role: "value": ["b1", "b2"].

boundary.description: Replace or delete: a container that other elements must be inside (or outside).

rules.message: Replace: say why a roleA element must not have an edge to a roleB element, and what to do instead.
Replace: say what a roleA element must be connected to. edge is outgoing, incoming or either.
Replace: use mustNotBeInside instead of mustBeInside to say the opposite.
Replace: every edge should say what it carries. property can also be { "tag": "key" }.
Replace: say what to do when the diagram grows past max elements. severity is error, warning or info.
